name: Chicken Noodle Soup
method: Bring 500 ml water to the boil with the stock and add the chicken breast. Simmer gently for 12 minutes until cooked through, then lift out and shred with two forks.
Add the sliced carrot and the noodles to the pan and cook for 4 minutes until tender. Slice the spring onion.
Return the chicken to the soup, ladle into a bowl and scatter over the spring onion. Serve with the bread.
